```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

    addrProto: 0,
});
const exampleInternetAddressConfig = new tencentcloud.dc.InternetAddressConfig("example", {
    instanceId: example.id,
    enable: true,
});
```

<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="go">

```go
package main

import (
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3/go/pulumi"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/dc"
)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		example, err := dc.NewInternetAddress(ctx, "example", &dc.InternetAddressArgs{
			MaskLen:   pulumi.Int(30),
			AddrType:  pulumi.Int(2),
			AddrProto: pulumi.Int(0),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = dc.NewInternetAddressConfig(ctx, "example", &dc.InternetAddressConfigArgs{
			InstanceId: example.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			Enable:     pulumi.Bool(true),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}
```

## Import



dc internet address config can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Dc/internetAddressConfig:InternetAddressConfig example ipv4-5091pc5v
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
